Chapter 6541: Sui’S Immortal Killer

Chapter 6541: Sui’s Immortal Killer

The barrier prevented the rays from penetrating Heaven World. Nevertheless, the swarm continued and scared the hell out of spectators.

This didn’t look like the ability of an immortal but more like a ravenous mad god. Heaven-slayers and primal ancestors were afraid all the same, being subjected to the same fate.

The barrier kept the swarm at bay but some still made it through. One region withered into a dead zone immediately upon being touched by an immortal beam.

“We’re lucky to have Supreme Black Ancestor.” An emperor said since the rays could have caused untold damage to Heaven World.

A hand stretched out from the palace next, also engulfed in dancing flames. Its target was none other than Supreme Black Ancestor.

His barrier was unbreakable for virtually everyone. An overlord would find breaking it exceedingly difficult. It could protect the world for eras to come.

However, the hand easily pierced through it without using any immortal power. This was something beyond an overlord, the master of an epoch.

In this split second, Black roared: “Activate!”

He revealed his true form - a robust divine bull the size of a small mountain with bulging muscles. His jet-black coat was lustrous as if it had been polished numerous times, inviting to the touch.

The world seemingly circled and existed just for him. Others had the urge to prostrate and worship him as the ruler.

He grasped a coarse stone hatchet resembling those used by prehistoric humans who came across an axe-shaped stone and tied it to a wooden handle with wild vines.

Despite its crude appearance, it had a dark-red glow of the immortal level.

“Sui’s Immortal Killer!” He roared and swung the hatchet, able to split an overlord into two halves.

This belonged to one of the three immortals - Firebringer Hatchet.

The hand prudently pulled back against the devastating swing. Nevertheless, Black’s barrier still crumbled.

With it gone, everyone saw a figure standing before the fiery palace.

An immortal power assaulted their world and horrified them.

“So this is an immortal...” Heaven-slayers and primal ancestors were suppressed, no different from the rest.

“Bao Pu?” Overlords within Heaven World became emotional.

“Bao Pu, since when did you become a coward?” Black couldn’t see the figure clearly due to the flames but there could be no other answer.

“Eating a corpse to become an immortal.” Those capable of seeing the figure were all ancient beings.

The progenitors from the same epoch as Bao Pu were left speechless.

“Come out!” Black shouted.

The figure took one step forward and the fiery palace moved with him. Heaven World couldn’t withstand their existence and cracks appeared everywhere. Weaker beings exploded into bloody mists.

“No, Heaven World can’t handle it!” Others became overwhelmed with shock.

“Clank!” A saber descended and blocked the figure’s path, causing the person to take one step back.
